title: Choose the look of Galaxy Wristore
question: New hand. Every card keeps your animated 3D Galaxy Watch and the Porsche app's premium feel; the roll assigned Blue-Hour Wrist Shot. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Open each card's sketch to see the phone screen as written.

options.label: Blue-Hour Wrist Shot
options.lineage: the wrist shots watch owners post, taken at blue hour
options.thesis: Your watch shot like a wrist shot: a living 3D Galaxy Watch at dusk, with everything else in soft focus around it.
options.viewport: The 3D watch at the classic three-quarter angle with your real face on its dial, turning slowly against a blurred dusk; hotspots on bezel, keys and caseback; one glass panel with the next step; tab bar.
options.risk: Dusk gradients and glass are popular; it stays ours only if the watch, its real face and the focus pull carry it.

raised.raise: Live figures (battery, storage, backup count) update in place digit by digit, never by reloading the screen.
Hotspot size carries urgency on one fixed ramp: what needs you grows, the rest stay pinpoints.
Storage is a hard budget: a restore shows what fits on the watch before anything is sent.
The face on the 3D dial is the watch's real picture at its true resolution, never faked sharper.
Backups compare at the same scale and angle, so before and after shows exactly what changed.

options.label: Night Showroom
options.lineage: car configurators and the Porsche app you sent
options.thesis: Your watch on a lit turntable like a car in a configurator: turn it, tap its hotspots, read its condition at a glance.
options.viewport: The 3D watch on a turntable over a mirrored floor; a condition bar above it; hotspots with leader lines to Faces, Apps and Backup; status tiles in frosted glass; tab bar.
options.risk: This is your reference almost literally, and the look many premium car apps share, so it is less our own.

options.label: Full-Screen Feed
options.thesis: One thing owns the screen at a time: your 3D watch first, then each face and app one swipe away.
options.viewport: The 3D watch fills the screen; its status anchored low left; a rail of Faces, Apps, Backup and Discover on the right; the next face waits one swipe up.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and everyone knows the gesture; wins for browsing faces, loses as the hub, where a feed hides what needs doing.
options.risk: Managing a watch by swiping a feed can mean scrolling past what needs attention.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Every figure about the watch on a clacking split-flap board.
options.viewport: The 3D watch above a board of flap rows: battery, storage, address, last backup.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a station board is not a watch owner's world, and flaps fight the 3D watch for attention.
options.kept: Figures update in place, digit by digit.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Faces and apps plotted as stars around the watch, sized by importance.
options.viewport: The watch at the centre of a star chart of its apps.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pretty for the Galaxy name, but a chart hides simple status.
options.kept: Size carries urgency on one fixed ramp.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: A backup as a mixtape: side A apps, side B files, timed to fit.
options.viewport: The backup listed like a tape's two sides.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nostalgic and handwritten, far from the premium 3D feel you pinned.
options.kept: Storage is a hard budget that must not overflow.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Pixel letterforms at poster scale as the app's voice.
options.viewport: A pixel headline over the watch.
options.case: Fuses poorly: retro pixels contradict a modern premium 3D app.
options.kept: Pixel honesty: show the real resolution.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: The watch through its life stages on matching plates.
options.viewport: Your watch before and after each backup, plate by plate.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream and engraved italics are the opposite of the dusk glass you pinned.
options.kept: Fixed scale and registration, so changes compare directly.
options.risk: Too quiet for a premium app.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What Galaxy Wearable and the Apple Watch app ship, with your 3D watch, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A large 3D picture of the watch, a row of face thumbnails, then grouped lists.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Samsung's own app by design.
